# Sample Postgres databases (neondatabase/postgres-sample-dbs)

Fixture SQL is an excerpt from [neondatabase/postgres-sample-dbs](https://github.com/neondatabase/postgres-sample-dbs) (sample Postgres databases for learning, testing, and development). Dumps are from pg_dump (Neon Serverless Postgres).

Used by pytest to verify we can parse real-world PostgreSQL DDL and generate synthetic data.

Source: `https://github.com/neondatabase/postgres-sample-dbs`  
Example: periodic_table (periodic table of elements), passenger (Titanic).
